item.title: Off-duty NYPD officer speaks out after saving mom, 2 daughters from Staten Island fire
item.description: Lt. James Heinz tore down a fence and then ripped out a window - all with his bare hands - to get the girls out of the burning house.

item.title: US stocks erase sharp losses, while oil prices leap on worries about Iran war
item.description: Oil prices leaped Monday on worries that war with Iran could clog the global flow of crude and make inflation even worse. U.S. stocks, meanwhile, swung from sharp losses to a tiny gain.

item.title: Live's 'After the Oscars Show' Countdown begins on Hollywood's biggest morning
item.description: Emmy Award-Winning Hosts Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos will host "Live with Kelly and Mark' at the Famed Dolby Theatre the morning after the Oscars.

item.title: Supreme Court preserves only GOP-held congressional district in New York City for 2026 elections
item.description: The justices halted the state court ruling that had ordered New York's redistricting commission to redraw the district held by Rep. Nicole Malliotakis that covers Staten Island and a small piece of Brooklyn.

item.title: NYPD on alert for potential cyber attacks following attack on Iran
item.description: Experts believe Iran and its proxies are weighing their options when it comes to cyber attacks.

item.title: Small plane crashes Hudson River in Newburgh; pilot and passenger rescued: officials
item.description: A mini version of the Miracle on the Hudson took place Monday night, 60 miles north of New York City.

item.title: New York City protests reflect contrasting response to US military strikes against Iran
item.description: Protestors at Columbus Circle say they don't want war with Iran, saying it will destabilize the region, put Americans in danger and be incredibly costly.

item.title: Officers in search and seizure of Luigi Mangione during arrest acted 'reasonably,' prosecutors say
item.description: The Manhattan district attorney's office said the Altoona police officers acted "in deliberate and painstaking fashion" when they arrested Mangione in a McDonald's and complied with Pennsylvania search-and-seizure law.

item.title: Newark-bound United flight returns to LA airport for evacuation after reported fire
item.description: The flight, which was en route to Newark, New Jersey, returned to LAX to address an issue with one of the engines, the airline said in a statement.

item.title: Children's and Family Emmy Awards held in NYC; Disney shatters record for most nominations
item.description: The Walt Disney Company shattered the record for most nominations, receiving 102.
